title: Voice of the customer (VOC): Definition, methods, and how to run a program
summary: Learn what Voice of the Customer (VOC) is, how to collect customer feedback, evaluate evidence, and build a practical VOC program.
body_markdown:
What does voice of the customer mean? +


Voice of the Customer is the practice of collecting and analyzing what customers say, think, and need so teams can make better business decisions. It can include customer satisfaction scores and other feedback data. Decision-ready VOC goes further by helping teams understand customer expectations and customer pain points, and what those findings mean for the business.


What are voice of customer examples? +


A company sees complaints about a new feature, and interviews reveal that the feature works fine but customers struggle to fit it into their existing workflow, so the product team keeps the feature and changes the design. Customer surveys show strong interest in a product while interviews reveal concerns about its price, so the marketing team changes its messaging to address the value customers expect. Customer success interactions show repeated complaints about account setup, and reviewing the customer journey reveals the exact step where customers get stuck, so the team simplifies the process.


What is voice of the customer in Six Sigma? +


In Six Sigma, Voice of the Customer captures what customers expect from a product, service, or process. Teams translate those expectations into Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) characteristics, which turn customer requirements into measurable specifications. These can then be used to assess whether a process is meeting the standards that matter to customers.


What is a voice of the customer tool? +


A Voice of the Customer tool helps businesses collect and analyze customer feedback. Survey platforms are useful when teams need structured responses from a larger customer population, while qualitative research platforms help when researchers need to explore customer views in more depth. Text analytics can help teams work through large volumes of existing feedback and identify recurring themes.


How does Amazon use voice of the customer? +


Amazon's approach to customer needs is reflected in its Customer Obsession leadership principle. The company describes this as starting with the customer and working backward, meaning teams begin by considering what customers need before deciding what to build. Amazon presents this approach as part of how it develops products and services and makes business decisions.


What does Gartner say about voice of the customer? +


Gartner covers voice of the customer in its customer experience research, which looks at how organizations collect, analyze, and act on feedback from across the customer journey.
